summary: Baidu filed a Form 6-K attaching a Hong Kong Exchange Next Day Disclosure Return (US equivalent: Form 8-K/insider buyback disclosure) covering an ongoing on-market share repurchase program. The company bought back roughly 560,000 Class A ordinary shares (stock code 09888) daily from September 7 to September 21, 2026, at prices ranging from HKD 86.909 to HKD 92.383, totaling about 6.13 million shares, each tranche roughly 0.025% of issued shares, pending cancellation. Issued shares held steady at 2,209,541,178 with zero treasury shares, signaling immediate cancellation rather than treasury retention. Watch execution pace, cash deployment, and any uplift to EPS or buyback-program expansion.
